defaultNetworks.description: List of networks to query for balance operations. If not specified, falls back to defaultNetwork only.

defaultWallet.description: Default wallet address for examples and testing

rpcProvider.description: RPC provider to use: 'url' for standard nodeURL from network config, 'helius' for Helius service, 'infura' for Infura service (uses apiKeys.infura), or 'chainstack' for Chainstack Platform API auto-discovery
